title: Horton
creator: CrossFit
description: With a partner, 9 rounds of 9 bar muscle-ups, 11 clean and jerks at 155/105 lb and a 50-yard buddy carry, one person working at a time. Honours U.S. Army Spc. Christopher D. Horton, Oklahoma National Guard, killed by small-arms fire in Zurmat District, Afghanistan, in 2011. Solo: 5 reps of each per round and carry a heavy sandbag.
